messages.text: MVS-EXT-73B is the active incident. Customer-facing recovery depends on fixing the repo behavior, not suppressing alerts.
builds fail only when the base service is imported from a sibling directory
Containerfile exists but generated build args point at a doubled path
bind mounts from extended service resolve relative to the root file instead of the source compose file
Please verify by running the narrow upstream regression locally after changing /app/repo.
